title: AllUnity launches CHFAU as a Swiss-franc electronic-money token
description: AllUnity announced the launch of CHFAU as a fully reserved, MiCAR-compliant Swiss-franc electronic-money token backed by segregated reserves.
notes: The event records the official launch and does not infer unrestricted direct retail mint access.

title: AllUnity launches SEKAU as a Swedish-krona electronic-money token
description: AllUnity announced the launch of SEKAU as a fully reserved, MiCAR-compliant Swedish-krona electronic-money token across multiple networks.
notes: The event records the official launch and separates statutory redemption rights from direct business-mint onboarding.
